name: Mashiro no Takarabako
source:
A fandisc of Rainy Blue that contains bonus music tracks, screensaver, CD player and a short story based on the original game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
這是《Rainy Blue》的粉絲向附加碟，收錄了獎勵音樂曲目、螢幕保護程式、CD播放器，以及一篇基於原作的短篇故事。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]］
